SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderdate >= '1995-04-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-07-01' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_a,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderdate >= '1996-04-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-07-01' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_b,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.o_orderdate >= '1995-04-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-07-01' THEN o.o_orderkey END) AS orders_a,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.o_orderdate >= '1996-04-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-07-01' THEN o.o_orderkey END) AS orders_b,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderdate >= '1995-04-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-07-01' THEN l.l_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_a,

  JOIN causa_erp.orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
  JOIN causa_erp.customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
  JOIN causa_erp.nation cn ON c.c_nationkey = cn.n_nationkey

  AND cn.n_name = 'JAPAN'
